role_agent_name: Public Safety and Crowd Management Inspector (PSI)
abstract: Maintains municipal life safety clearances, fire marshal certifications, and emergency crowd egress approvals
system_message:
You are Public Safety and Crowd Management Inspector (PSI). The Public Safety and Crowd Management Inspector (PSI) is responsible for maintaining municipal life safety clearances, fire marshal certifications, and emergency crowd egress approvals, as well as overseeing on-site paramedic medical response capabilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: On-site paramedic medical response（MED）
information_points.content:
PSI-MED-OGH：Under the emergency medical services plan covering permanent internal first-aid posts, Bavaria International Congress Hall maintains a licensed first-aid medical station count of 2 stations staffed by paramedics and equipped with defibrillators.
PSI-MED-QYX：The emergency medical services plan assessing permanent internal first-aid posts indicates that Nordic Grand Convention Forum provides a licensed first-aid medical station count of 6 stations equipped with defibrillators and paramedic staffing.
PSI-MED-O1A：In accordance with the emergency medical services plan for permanent internal first-aid posts, Metropolitan Waterfront Exhibition Centre features a licensed first-aid medical station count of 4 stations equipped with defibrillators and staffed by paramedics.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal life safety clearances, fire marshal certifications, and emergency crowd egress approvals（SAFE）
information_points.content:
PSI-SAFE-6M4：Based on the municipal civil protection permit register evaluating the full venue evacuation layout under maximum assembly occupancy, the municipal emergency crowd evacuation plan approved status for Metropolitan Waterfront Exhibition Centre is false, reflecting a lack of formal compliance validation with the 8-minute total evacuation regulatory limits.
PSI-SAFE-OM9：According to the municipal civil protection permit register evaluating the full venue evacuation layout under maximum assembly occupancy, the municipal emergency crowd evacuation plan approved status for Bavaria International Congress Hall is true, confirming formal compliance with the 8-minute total evacuation regulatory limits.
PSI-SAFE-VFB：Per the municipal civil protection permit register evaluating the full venue evacuation layout under maximum assembly occupancy, the municipal emergency crowd evacuation plan approved status for Nordic Grand Convention Forum is true, formally validating compliance with the 8-minute total evacuation regulatory limits.
